images.description: Stylish 6-piece Cello opalware dinner plate set with a refined designer pattern. Microwave and dishwasher safe. Perfect as a starter set or a thoughtful housewarming gift.

images.name: Cello Imperial Dessert Set 7 Pcs

images.name: Cello Veg Bowl Set 6Pcs

images.name: Cello Cup & Saucer Regular 12 Pcs
images.description: Complete 12-piece Cello cup and saucer set for formal and casual tea service. Crafted from durable opalware with a smooth pearlescent finish. Microwave and dishwasher safe.

images.name: Cello Recca Mug 4 Pcs

images.name: Cello Ricca Sisley Vogue Mug 6Pcs
